name: localmod
description: Local-first desktop studio for open-weight models — React + Electron for Mac & Windows
author: Smit Gaikwad

scripts.desktop: concurrently -k -n engine,ui,electron -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:engine" "npm run dev:ui" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:4781/health http://127.0.0.1:1420 && cross-env LOCALMOD_EXTERNAL_ENGINE=1 electron apps/desktop/electron/main.cjs"
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --win --publish never
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
